summary: The Crew is a cooperative trick-taking game where each hand the team must silently agree on a plan to complete specific card-winning tasks, using an extremely limited one-time signal to help. It's tense and puzzle-like, escalating in difficulty across a 50-mission campaign.
praised: ingenious minimal-communication co-op twist on trick-taking
escalating campaign structure keeps it fresh
creates genuine tense deduction without a rulebook of chatter
quick to teach for trick-taking fans
criticised: strict communication limits frustrate players who want to talk more
a single mistake can doom the whole mission
less appealing to those who dislike trick-taking fundamentals
quieter/more analytical players may dominate signal usage

interaction.detail: All players contribute cards to the same sequence of shared tricks, and each trick's outcome depends on everyone's plays together toward common and individual task goals. There is no competition, blocking, or attacking; interaction is purely coordinative, constrained by strict communication limits rather than dealmaking.

scoring.how_you_win: The team is dealt a hand of tasks (cards each player must win in specific tricks, sometimes in order) and coordinates with a single limited communication token; a mission is won only if every assigned task is completed exactly as required, with campaign progress measured by how many of the 50 numbered missions the group clears.

_name: The Crew: The Quest for Planet Nine
